en.html:
Gone. The ship was nowhere on the sea.

Had a wave swallowed it in one instant?
No, even then...

Kageaki"Muramasa, do you know what just happened?"
Muramasa《............》
Muramasa《Just now... a time distortion. Right there.》
Kageaki"...What...?"
Muramasa《That ship... was taken IN OUR PLACE.》
Muramasa《Which means, now we can't—》

en.html:
........................

What was I supposed to think?

Regret my own foolish haste? Wonder about the strange fate that ship and its crew would probably face now?

Either way, I had lost the means of getting back to our world. Time to think and worry, though—haan. Of THAT I had plenty.

ja.html:
……………………。

　何を思えば良いのかわからなかった。

　己の軽挙を悔やめば良いのか。
　これから数奇な運命を辿るだろう船とその乗組員に
ついて思いを馳せれば良いのか。

　いずれにせよ。
　元の世界へ戻る手蔓を失った俺には、考え悩む時間
だけなら充分にあった……。
